_doc: pvscore 5.1 text / image layer (tools/v51_text). Pre-registered 10-18 before any model-side score was computed. GT-side margins and model-side curves; per-time view rules are imported from tools/v51_pilot/view_score.py (pair_ok, cell_score, cell_chance, height_score, height_chance, facing curve, FACING_CHANCE) and its view_thresholds.json, so text, image and video share one rulebook. Values from docs/SCORER_5_1_DESIGN.md where it gives them. A change after a look at model scores gets a new file thresholds_r1.json and a note in data/v51_text/README.md.

elements._doc: GT elements that carry facts. Every GT object is rendered as an occluder; facts are made only for the eligible ones.
elements.space_rule: 3D facts only among elements of the same GT space (space None -> GT space_of_point). View facts: indoor shot space -> only elements of that space; outdoor shot space -> elements of every outdoor space (no walls between them)
elements.model_untagged: untagged model instances are not candidates (no class to pair by, design §3)

R1._doc: L1 facts whose apex A is a named entity at a GT track sample time where its position is stated (Track.known), B and C static elements of the same space; model position = body centre at the 5.0.9 warped time

S3.model_person_h: median over model person bodies of the 95th-percentile body extent (top - base) in model units, i.e. the quantity 5.0.9 Timeline ref_h is built from before its GT-metre scaling and 1.55 floor, so it shares units with the model instance heights; none -> S3 facts missing (clarified 10-18 while writing model_side.py, before any model score)

layout_credit: fact score x min class credit of its elements (5.0.9 Credit: exact 1, similar 0.75)

matching._doc: design §3: named by id; unnamed by class (credit > 0, untagged excluded), initialised by Hungarian on 1 - credit, then local search (move to a free candidate / swap with another GT object) maximising the weighted sum of the item's 3D fact scores (L1 + L2 + R1 + S); one global correspondence per (item, model), also used for the view facts
matching.candidate_space: a model candidate may stand for an unnamed GT element only when its model space tag equals the GT element space or is None; named GT elements map to the model body of the same id (credit 1). Clarified 10-18 while writing score.py, before any model score
matching.restarts_doc: restart 0 = Hungarian init; restarts 1.. = random greedy init (seeded); best objective kept

chance_3d._doc: design §4: geometry (xy, long, short, height) of the model candidates is permuted jointly within each GT space (named bodies included), the correspondence re-chosen with the same matcher, the same facts rechecked; R = mean P over the permutations

view._doc: GT frames: GT boxes (+ persons and moving entities where the track states the position) ray-cast from the GT camera on a 96-wide grid at the output aspect; elements read like the model frames (visible pixels -> centroid, 3x3 cell, bbox height, median z-depth).
view.text_times: 1 fps grid t0 + 0.5 + k (t < t1 - 0.25) plus each camera sample time clamped into [t0 + 0.25, t1 - 0.25]; a time is kept when the GT pose there is stated: the camera is constant on the segment holding t, or t is within 0.5 s of a sample; a sample with open (null) parts makes its segment unstated
view.image_times: one frame per photo at the GT camera time; model frame = the prompt's frame range for that photo (frame round(t * fps)), its model shot, nearest grid frame (no pose alignment)
view.text_model_time: pvscore 5.0.9 camera.model_time_for (cut warp), nearest grid frame of that model shot, |dt| <= view_thresholds frame_max_dt_s
view.sigma_screen: unc_m / (depth * 2 tan(fov / 2)) per axis; the margins above are widened by sigma_k * sigma
view.facing: persons only. GT yaw at t: a stated track yaw within 0.5 s while the person moves < 0.3 m over +-0.5 s, or the direction of motion while moving >= 0.8 m/s on a known track span
view.occlusion: inventoried only: GT element whose unoccluded projection covers >= 0.005 of the frame but with < 0.2 of it visible (occluder = the element covering most of it); not scored (the model dump holds only visible surfaces)
view.chance: presence R = 0; position: view_score.cell_chance; size: view_score.height_chance; facing: view_score.FACING_CHANCE; screen_order / depth_order: permutation of (centre, depth) among the model frame's visible non-surface elements, 200 perms, seed 0 (as view_score.make_perm)

blocks.layer3d_doc: design §6 A2 weights for the blocks this layer computes (L3-L6 stay 5.0 rules), renormalised over the blocks the item has
blocks.R1: reported apart (design puts it in B1)
blocks.view_doc: equal weights over the blocks the item has; screen_order = left/right + above/below
blocks.layer: 0.5 layer3d + 0.5 view (summary for the T5-lite Spearman only)
blocks.block_score: clip((P - R) / (1 - R), 0, 1) x coverage; P = weighted mean over present facts, coverage = present weight / all weight

fact_weight: 3D facts: each element's weight (conf x named_weight if named) spread evenly over the facts of the block it is in; a fact's weight is the mean of its elements' shares. View facts: weight 1 each (as the video pilot)
